gen-dafont-starborn-gf-lexend-deca: Starborn scatters its letters across wide gaps of blank space, dreamy and weightless. Lexend Deca follows in a plain, unshaded sans, its small capitals tucked beside big lowercase, which grounds the drifting heading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-liter: Liter reads modern and sure, a sans with no stroke contrast at all and lowercase that stands tall in every line. Starborn floats above it, spaced out and dreamy.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-mada: Mada is a friendly sans with curves that stay open and a lowercase that towers in the middle of each line. Starborn drifts and dreams up top; Mada simply gets the words across.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-martel-sans: Starborn leaves huge gaps between its letters, with a dark, thick stripe of lowercase running through every line. Martel Sans is the grounded half, with generous openings in each curve.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-matangi: Matangi presses strokes like twine into a flat surface, with rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase. And Starborn, spaced wide and dreamy above, feels like a thin steel rod bent into every letter beside it.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-maven-pro: Starborn spreads its letters across wide gaps, giving each line a dreamy, weightless feel. Maven Pro brings a gentle monotone line, with zero stroke contrast and a welcoming gap in the c.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-michroma: Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips on every word. Starborn shares that spaciousness, though its dark lowercase stripe is far denser.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads like drawn wire, with an s that opens between its bends and a lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals. And Starborn, ethereal and widely spaced, lets the lines flow without any shading from thick to thin.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Dreamy and ethereal, Starborn spaces its letters far apart, while Mochiy Pop One hangs a very large lowercase eye on a single stroke width. Their spacing and heft differ, yet both stay unshaded and calm.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Starborn spreads its letters across wide gaps of blank space. Mochiy Pop P One has a sizable lowercase and no hairlines at all, so a modest size for the sans-serif body would sit comfortably below it.
